title: 2021 Nissan Altima Dent Repair
summary: Rear panel and hood dent repair with color-matched painting on a blue 2021 Nissan Altima.
story: A 2021 Nissan Altima came in with a dent in the rear quarter panel and a crease running along the hood edge. Both needed the metal worked back to true before any paint went near them, so the body lines would read straight again in daylight.
Carlos straightened the panel and the hood, then levelled, sanded and primed the repaired areas ready for refinishing.
The blue was mixed to the car's factory color code and blended into the surrounding panels, so the repaired hood and quarter panel match the rest of the car rather than announcing themselves.
